title: The Letter From The Ocean — EN/FR/HI (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar trilingual storytelling 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan vocal English French Hindi language learning warm absurdist observational
lyrics:
[Intro - piano, warm and curious]
A man found a bottle on the beach
Green glass, sealed with a cork
He pulled out a letter
It was from the ocean

[Verse 1 - English]
The ocean had several concerns
Primarily regarding how it was being described
It objected to the word deep
It found the word blue reductive
It had prepared a list of preferred adjectives
The list was seventeen pages long
The list was not enclosed
It said the list was available on request
He wrote to the return address
The return address was the ocean

[Verse 2 - Français]
La lettre venait de l'océan
(The letter was from the ocean)
L'océan avait plusieurs préoccupations
(The ocean had several concerns)
Il s'opposait au mot profond
(It objected to the word deep)
Il trouvait le mot bleu réducteur
(It found the word blue reductive)
Il avait préparé une liste de qualificatifs préférés
(It had prepared a list of preferred adjectives)
La liste faisait dix-sept pages
(The list was seventeen pages long)
La liste n'était pas jointe
(The list was not enclosed)
Elle était disponible sur demande
(It was available on request)
Il écrivit à l'adresse de retour
(He wrote to the return address)
L'adresse de retour était l'océan
(The return address was the ocean)

[Chorus - हिन्दी Hindi]
पत्र समुद्र से था
(The letter was from the ocean)
समुद्र को कई चिंताएं थीं
(The ocean had several concerns)
यह शब्द "गहरा" पर आपत्ति करता था
(It objected to the word deep)
इसे शब्द "नीला" संकुचित लगता था
(It found the word blue reductive)
पसंदीदा विशेषणों की एक सूची
(A list of preferred adjectives)
सत्रह पृष्ठ लंबी
(Seventeen pages long)
सूची संलग्न नहीं थी
(The list was not enclosed)
अनुरोध पर उपलब्ध
(Available on request)

[Bridge - all three]
He is still waiting for a reply
Il attend encore une réponse
वह अभी भी उत्तर की प्रतीक्षा कर रहा है
The ocean has not written back — L'océan n'a pas répondu — समुद्र ने वापस नहीं लिखा
He considers this consistent with the ocean's general communication style
Il considère cela cohérent avec le style de communication général de l'océan
वह इसे समुद्र की सामान्य संचार शैली के अनुरूप मानता है

[Outro]
He no longer calls it deep
Il ne l'appelle plus profond
वह इसे अब गहरा नहीं कहता
Or blue — Ou bleu — या नीला
He is working on preferred adjectives of his own
Il travaille sur ses propres qualificatifs préférés
वह अपने पसंदीदा विशेषणों पर काम कर रहा है
